item.title: Stephanie Joosten ci ha conquistato con i suoi discorsi e i suoi occhi di ghiaccio! ❄️😍
item.description:
Stephanie Joosten ci ha conquistato con i suoi discorsi e i suoi occhi di ghiaccio! ❄️😍
Con grande dolcezza e carisma, ci ha raccontato cosa significa essere il volto di Quiet in Metal Gear Solid V: un ruolo in cui l’espressione nasce dal corpo e dal movimento, più che dalla parola. 🎮✨

Ci ha portati indietro agli inizi della sua carriera, condividendo il suo rapporto con il mondo dei videogiochi — vissuto nella doppia prospettiva di spettatrice e di attrice. Un incontro che ci ha fatto scoprire la profondità dietro uno dei personaggi più iconici del gaming. 💫

item.description:
𝐖𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐝𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐞𝐦𝐝 𝐠𝐚𝐦𝐞-𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐟𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐞 𝐉𝐨𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧
Vraag je @stefaniejoosten (36) wat ze precies doet, dan krijg je geen eenduidig antwoord. Ze is onder meer actrice, zangeres, model én wereldwijd bekend als personage in een populaire videogame - haar talent laat zich nu eenmaal niet vangen in één hokje. Inmiddels werkt ze vanuit Limburg aan projecten die haar van Japan tot de Verenigde Staten brengen. Deze veelzijdige carrière leidt de Roermondse in november zelfs naar de Royal Albert Hall in Londen. In het sfeervolle @kasteeltje_hattem spreekt Navenant Magazine met Stefanie over haar leven in Tokio, haar rol in de game-industrie en de provincie die voor haar altijd als thuis zal blijven voelen: Limburg.

Lees meer: https://bit.ly/4eOxrAN

#navenant #navenantmagazine #limburg #stefaniejoosten #gameactrice #games

item.title: Known for her role in Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain, Stefanie Joosten's Portrayal of Quiet is unforgettable.
item.description:
Known for her role in Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain, Stefanie Joosten's Portrayal of Quiet is unforgettable.

Stefanie was born and grew up in Netherlands, and she's an otaku just like most of us so she learned Japanese and got into a student exchange programe in Japan. Then she decided to move to Japan where she dabbled in modeling and acting for commercials.

It was there where she landed the role of Quiet. She also sang Quiet's theme herself, the song that is so meaningful for all MGSV players.

In early 2019, Joosten joined the cast of Spacelords as Sööma.
In 2021, she joined the cast of Wanted: Dead, appeared on the soundtrack for the game and also contributed to the project as the lead cinematic director.

She had also released a couple of singing albums, Singing to the sky (2022) and Intermission (2023). Her genre is heavily influence by 80s city pop, those who love this genre should give em a listen!

And now in 2024, she is coming to Malaysia for the very first time with her very first SEA appearance in an event!

She'll be having panel sessions, autograph meet and greet and as well as photography ops with the fans too!

Her tokens is now live at https://ticketnation.my/asia-pop-con-24

Head on there to purchase them as tokens and tickets are limited!!

For more details, visit Asiapopcon.com
